seedTerms: Being the bearer of bad news

jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Emergency Rates
jokes.joke: I locked myself out of my house on the way to a black-tie wedding. The locksmith took one look at my tuxedo and charged me $350. He opened the door in twelve seconds. For that kind of money, I wanted him to struggle a little. Fake a cramp. Call an older locksmith who comes out of retirement for one last job.

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: The Locksmith Diagnosis
seedTermsUsed: Being the bearer of bad news
jokes.joke: I locked myself out last week, so I called a locksmith. Guy shows up, looks at my door for two seconds, and goes, 'I gotta be honest with you.' I said, 'please don't,' because nothing good has ever followed those words except maybe a surprise party. He goes, 'this lock gave up before I got here. I'm basically just the guy who confirms time of death.' I paid him ninety dollars to diagnose a door.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: Black Tie Lockout
jokes.joke: I locked myself out of my apartment last weekend right before a black tie event, so I had to call a locksmith while standing on the porch in a rented tuxedo. He pulls up in a rusty van, takes one look at my bow tie, and starts charging me like I own the building. Honestly, nothing ruins formalwear faster than begging a stranger to break into your own home for two hundred dollars while holding a cummerbund.

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.title: Thorough Service
jokes.joke: I locked myself out of my car and called a locksmith. The guy who showed up was so pushy he never even asked what was wrong. He just went straight to work and said, 'Relax, I've got this.' Thirty seconds later the driver's door was open... along with the passenger door, the trunk, the hood, and the glove box. He looked at me and said, 'I like to be thorough.'

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Unlocked Career
jokes.joke: I hired one of those life coaches who keeps saying, "You have so much untapped potential." After six months I still hadn't accomplished anything, so I fired him and called a locksmith. In ten minutes the locksmith actually fixed the thing that was locked. Apparently my potential was behind a deadbolt.
